newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira to issue five mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Kemira to issue five mln new shares.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Thursday it will issue five million new shares and the Finnish state will sell 16 million Kemira shares to investors at home and abroad.
"The share issue is expected to bring Kemira about 250 million markka in new share capital," Kemira said.
The lead managers of the offering have an option to sell an additional three million new Kemira shares, and the state has the option to sell a further two million shares, Kemira said.
"The use of the option to increase the number of new shares to be issued would raise the increase in share capital to about 400 million markka," Kemira said.
Kemira did not give any details about the subscription period or about the issue price. Kemira's share closed at 52.50 markka on Wednesday in Helsinki, down 0.40.
The state owns 72.3 percent of shares and is authorised by the parliament to lower its holding to 50.1 percent.
The government said in September it planned to decrease the state's ownership to "around 55 percent taking into account any new shares to be included in the offering by Kemira".
Kemira said the funds to be raised would be used to expand its core business activities through acquisitions or other investments. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-0-6805 0245
